deferred.name: dolt_reset('--hard') commits the active SQL transaction
deferred.reason: Dolt reset commits an active SQL transaction; the native adapter requires idle transactions. This semantic difference needs its own contract, not an inserted COMMIT that would erase the assertion.

deferred.name: dolt_reset(rev) moves HEAD, resets the index, and leaves the working tree alone
deferred.reason: Mixed reset and staged/working tree separation have no D1 counterpart. Only hard reset is currently supported.

deferred.name: CALL DOLT_RESET('--hard') should reset the merge state after uncommitted merge
deferred.reason: Merge-state reset requires merge and abort operations beyond the current vc.core adapter contract.
